title: Russell Winter
description:
I’m going to show basically every aspect of what I know and how I do things. I will post about stuff and include actual screen shots, pictures, statements, and documents. Maybe some videos of day in the life or the joys of defense contracting...

I’ll break down the inner workings of not just turning raw metal into finished tooling or parts, but also working with customers, banks, lawyers, the government, family/business and family-business dynamics, personal/business finances, and raising a young family through this.

title: Hertel Walking Study
where: Hertel Avenue industrial corridor, Buffalo, New York. Exact meeting point to be confirmed.
description: A walking field study of the Hertel industrial corridor and surrounding residential streets: company frontages, industrial reuse, freight and pedestrian crossings, and everyday residential routes. Research briefings, source links, two full PDF reports and an indexed parcel map are available in the Research MAG. This is a proposed reporting itinerary, with the exact meeting point still to be confirmed.

title: New York State Innovation Summit and Commercialization Competition
presenter: FuzeHub and Empire State Development / NYSTAR
where: Buffalo Convention Center, Buffalo, New York
description: Manufacturers, researchers, entrepreneurs and investors gather in Buffalo for technology showcases and discussions on commercialization, advanced materials, energy innovation, biotechnology and artificial intelligence. Nine startup finalists will compete for four awards totaling $430,000 to advance prototypes and go-to-market plans. Registration and the agenda are available through the organizer. Awards have not yet been decided.

title: Axenica Bioscience advances viral reference-material manufacturing project
description: Buffalo-based Axenica Bioscience is a finalist in New York State's 2026 Commercialization Competition. Its project develops characterized, traceable viral reference materials to help diagnostic developers and laboratories evaluate tests against contemporary strains. The company will compete at the October 27–28 Innovation Summit in Buffalo. Finalist selection was announced September 30; it is not an award of funding or an announcement of a new company formation.
